amharic._contamination_note: 4,736 of the 81,224 Amharic evaluation words (5.8%) occur in data/segmented/amharic_morpheme_segmented.json, which constrained MoVoC-Tok training. Use scripts/evaluate_intrinsic.py --exclude-training to score the 76,488 held-out words. See evaluation/CONTAMINATION.md.
amharic._note: test_set/provenance paths are relative to this repository root. sources[].source paths are historical provenance from the amseg project where this data was originally assembled, and are not paths within this repository.

sources._tier_caveat: The tier describes this file's role, not disjointness from the training resource: 18 of the 160 words contributed here also occur in data/segmented/tigrinya_morpheme_segmented.json, which constrained MoVoC-Tok training. See evaluation/CONTAMINATION.md.

tigrinya._contamination_note: words_contributed records the first source each word was drawn from, so it undercounts overlap with the training resource. 2,786 of the 5,224 Tigrinya evaluation words occur in data/segmented/tigrinya_morpheme_segmented.json (2,412 labelled from it, plus 356 labelled postedited_morphemes.json and 18 labelled gold_morphemes.json). Use scripts/evaluate_intrinsic.py --exclude-training, which filters by set membership against the training file. See evaluation/CONTAMINATION.md.
